title: Trial Offer
description:
Trial offers let you define free or paid introductory pricing for a subscription item.
A TrialOffer specifies the price to charge during the trial, how many billing intervals
the trial lasts, and what price the subscription item transitions to when the trial ends.
You attach a TrialOffer to a subscription item
using `items[current_trial][trial_offer]` when creating or updating a subscription.

active.description: Whether the trial offer is active. Set to false to archive the trial offer.

livemode.description: If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.

nickname.description: A brief description of the trial offer, hidden from customers.

object.description: String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value.

price.description: The price during the trial offer.
